note: Read 2026-10-30 on lta.gov.ws. Its page on drivers licences gives a new drivers licence, valid for 5 years, at $173 for local citizens ($315 for overseas citizens, not held), paid after passing the theory and practical tests; a learner must be 16 and holds a learner's licence for 3 months. No other age for the licence is given, so it is kept from 16, the youngest a learner can start. The learner's licence ($79) and the commercial classes aren't held. The identity card is not this office's.

sources.title: Land Transport Authority Samoa, Information on Drivers License
sources.said: New Drivers License (Valid for 5 years) $173 for Local Citizens ... When you pass both theory and practical you pay the cost of the Drivers License as stated. ... LEARNERS Drivers 16 years of age – valid for 3 months
